notes: Additive evidence only. Frozen snapshots and original holds remain unchanged.
These are ten rechecks inside the previously checked 111-record manifest, not ten new guides.
Only parsed operator-site material may support follow-up candidate facts; other sources remain identity context.
Failed retrieval describes this tool outcome, not business closure. Indexed and parsed representations may be cached.
Review date is not source publication time. Source truth, availability, ownership and licensing are not certified.
